about: todo-gui model and script mutants. Killers are the examples suite (examples:todo-gui: its laws, tests and CLI cases); each rule names the law or case that kills it.

mutants.name: x-gui-flip-keeps-the-count
mutants.from: left = if it.Done { left + 1 } else { left - 1 }
mutants.rule: LeftCountsOpenItems: marking an item changes the open count kept with the list.

mutants.name: x-gui-remove-keeps-the-count
mutants.rule: AddThenRemoveRestores: removing the open item just added takes it off the open count.

mutants.name: x-gui-clear-keeps-done
mutants.rule: ClearDoneKeepsOpen: ClearDone keeps exactly the open items.

mutants.name: x-gui-blank-added
mutants.rule: BlankAddsNothing: an Add of spaces adds no item.

mutants.name: x-gui-typed-text-trimmed
mutants.rule: cases/play: a typed text of spaces stays a step (type LABEL<TAB>   ), which a trimmed line refuses as no step.
